# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary assessment artifacts generated during architecture and workflow analysis.

- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md) — Two-layer view of application and component architecture.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md) — Categorized dependency landscape with compatibility observations.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md) — API inventory and service communication contracts.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md) — Persistence model, data ownership, and sensitivity analysis.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md) — Externalized configuration, runtime profiles, and secrets inventory.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md) — Core domain workflows and decision logic.
